organization.summary: Company behind Colibri, described on its website as a stateless Ethereum light client that checks cryptographic proofs instead of trusting an RPC provider. The proposal gives Germany as its location; its GitHub organization corpus-core was created 2025-01-13.

claims.claim: The colibri-stateless repository is public, MIT licensed and maintained.
claims.method: GitHub API: MIT, created 2025-01-20, last push 2026-11-27, latest release v3.2.1 on 2026-11-21.

claims.claim: The Kohaku wallet SDK references Colibri.
claims.method: The README on HEAD describes provider helpers that wrap Colibri and shows a colibri import. This shows code support, not usage levels.
The file on HEAD imports Colibri provider and prover URL helpers. This shows code support, not usage levels.

claims.claim: Freedom browser lists Colibri as primary for a chain.

claims.claim: Colibri bindings are available for JavaScript/TypeScript, Swift, Kotlin/Java, Python, Dart/Flutter and Rust.
claims.method: The bindings folder lists dart, kotlin, node-addon, python, rust and swift (plus emscripten and docker). Directory presence does not show a working binding. No Go binding was seen, which matches the proposal's statement that the grant pays for it.
